description-guitar: The Basic Acoustic Guitar Class, organized by Viet Vibe Foundation (VVF), offers 90-minute weekly lessons (18:00-19:30 Thursday) from February 27th to June 5th 2025 (Performance night). Led by three experienced instructors—Michael Nguyen (Trong Nguyen), Eattle Nguyen (Hoi Anh Nguyen), and Eric Nguyen (Tue Nguyen)—the program is designed for a maximum of 12 participants, with a minimum of 5 students required.
description-introduction: Don't miss out our classes - secure your spot at your preferable events with our easy online ticket purchasing system and join it to connect with our supportive community.
description-step01: Find and select the events you want to attend. You can filter events by date, location, and price.
description-step02: Fill in the registration form with your personal information to let us know you are attending the event.
description-step03: Make payments through our secure payment system and receive your reservation confirmation email.
memberProcess: To become a VVF member, please refer to the registration form using the registration button below
